consolidated_summary: Before irritation of the parietal peritoneum in appendicitis, there is appendiceal obstruction followed by appendiceal distension. These stages precede the third stage — irritation of the parietal peritoneum — which is followed by perforation and peritonitis. The sequence is well-documented in the time course of appendicitis.
